<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Galvanoscale](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=495)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 152

An interesting characteristic among a number of Golarion's reptiles is their capacity to generate or manipulate electrical current. While there doesn't seem to be a single reason for this quality, enough species possess it for scholars to have created a category of reptiles known as galvanoscales.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Giant Coppermouth](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3283) (Creature 7), [Lightning Turtle](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3284) (Creature 12), [Magnetic Gecko](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3282) (Creature 1)
